proposed_from.topic: Three-dose ordinal unique-peak facets under weak individual unimodality. For every finite L>=2, define Q3,L as the convex hull of the three unique-best-dose indicators and the three randomized arm marginals over all ordinal response triples excluding a strict middle valley. Prove that one fixed CHECK_2BTAS-accepted two-pass bounded triangular-affine stream, with finite-state certificate labels and no arithmetic guards or semantic oracle, soundly, completely, and uniquely emits every primitive canonical cut or weighted facet. Derive finitely many geometric predecessor types and a fixed transfer recurrence for facet counts; then compute sharp coordinate endpoints and endpoint-attaining mixtures and construct exact support-aware simultaneous endpoint inference with pointwise scalar efficiency on separated positive-support faces. Consumer: Goodwin et al. 2022 three-dose psilocybin trial, using a prespecified ordinal benefit-risk outcome and reporting unimodality as an added assumption. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: Exact prefix/suffix-minimum algebra yields 3^(L-3) distinct primitive weighted facets with unique affine predecessors and three successors; doubling and Fibonacci coefficient families survive exhaustive checks through L=9. Exact rational certificates give complete facet counts 59, 197, and 721 for L=3,4,5, and every coordinate endpoint reduces to affine combinations of at most three full facets, with three sometimes necessary. Boundary, tie, zero-cell, deletion, grammar-obstruction, generic-OT, and current-literature checks found no fatal collision with the final contract. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Classify every tight-product extremizer and rank pattern into finitely many geometric predecessor types whose affine extensions admit one sound, complete, uniquely generating 16-register two-pass triangular source, including the staircase/Fibonacci family. EARLY KILL TEST: Construct a literal accepted source for every three-letter staircase word, replay through L=9, and match it one-to-one against the exact L=3,4,5 catalogs; missing rows, duplicate traces, forbidden dependencies, or a proof excluding every permitted encoding forces pivot. seed_details.opportunity: Classify every primitive facet of the three-dose non-valley coupling polytope and compile the classification into one fixed exact-once bounded-register stream.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the generic polynomial-program reduction and branch-and-bound search by a classification of the five prefix/suffix tight-product types and their augmented-rank transitions.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for three-treatment ordinal unique-best facets, non-valley coupling polytopes, and all-support facet recurrences found numerical discrete optimizers and generic multi-marginal transport, but no matching analytic catalogue.
seed_details.cynical_objection: Immediate from DuarteEtAl2024 because the target is a finite discrete causal bound.
seed_details.rebuttal: DuarteEtAl2024 proves reduction to polynomial optimization and asymptotic sharpness of an anytime solver; it does not give an irredundant symbolic H-representation, a unique predecessor map, or a fixed all-support counting recurrence.

seed_details.opportunity: Derive finite max-min formulas for all six unique-best endpoints and prove that three full facets always suffice and are sometimes necessary.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the lower- or upper-triangular two-way coupling constructed from cumulative inequalities by an extreme dual decomposition in the three target coordinates followed by a forbidden-support completion.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for three-arm ordinal unique-best probabilities and symbolic multi-marginal benefit bounds found only pairwise benefit formulas and generic transport programs.
seed_details.cynical_objection: Immediate from finite linear-program duality because there are only three target coordinates.
seed_details.rebuttal: The support-three conclusion is generic polyhedral input, but the publishable content requires the complete canonical facet family, explicit endpoint branches, necessity of three, and response-triple mixtures at ties and zero cells.

seed_details.opportunity: Permit an \(\varepsilon\)-share of strict middle valleys and derive the piecewise-affine critical violation mass at which each positive unique-best lower bound disappears.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the conditional \(c\)-dependence and rank-invariance relaxation by a mass budget on a named forbidden response-type subset inside a three-marginal transport dual.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches pairing ordinal unimodality violations with breakdown frontiers found IV monotonicity relaxations and generic assumption deletion, but no strict-middle-valley mass frontier.
seed_details.cynical_objection: Immediate from MastenPoirier2020 after renaming the relaxation parameter.
seed_details.rebuttal: The relaxed feasible set here changes a three-way forbidden support, so its breakpoints and active weighted facets are not the binary-selection frontier of Masten and Poirier.

seed_details.opportunity: Construct one simultaneous confidence region for all six endpoint coordinates that remains honest at support loss and facet ties while reducing to efficient scalar Wald inference on separated faces.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace global random perturbation of an arbitrary linear program by exact conditional multinomial inversion on a pilot-localized active-facet set, with a full-support fallback.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for support-adaptive simultaneous inference for finite max-min endpoint maps found perturbed-LP coverage and directional bootstrap theory, but no procedure combining zero-cell honesty with regular-face scalar efficiency.
seed_details.cynical_objection: Immediate from ChoRussell2024 or FangSantos2019 because endpoint maps are finite maxima and minima.
seed_details.rebuttal: Those papers diagnose or regularize non-smooth value maps, but do not provide exact support-aware six-coordinate coverage together with oracle scalar efficiency when arm cells and endpoint variances can vanish.

seed_details.anchor: Bonet2001, Sections 2--3 and the discrete instrumental-test construction
seed_details.opportunity: Characterize why the non-valley support evades pairwise compatibility graphs and derive a minimal higher-order hypergraph inequality basis for its observable-and-target projection.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace pairwise compatibility edges by three-uniform legal-response hyperedges before taking the projected marginal-and-peak polytope.
seed_details.destination_search: The later KaidoPonomarev2025 graph framework covers general support restrictions, but its regular maximal-clique condition fails because all pairwise arm combinations are compatible while some triples are not.
seed_details.cynical_objection: Immediate from the general nonregular inequalities of KaidoPonomarev2025.
seed_details.rebuttal: Their graph expansion yields testable marginal inequalities; it does not classify the mixed peak-coordinate facets or give a bounded-state predecessor calculus for this hypergraph projection.

seed_details.opportunity: Build an output-sensitive reverse-search enumerator for canonical non-valley facets using a geometric parent map and no visited-output set.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace generic spatial branch-and-bound nodes by facet-specific rank signatures and a canonical renormalized deletion parent.
seed_details.destination_search: AvisFukuda1996 supplies the exact-once parent-tree method, but searches found no specialization to response-type facet families with changing dimension.
seed_details.cynical_objection: Immediate from AvisFukuda1996 once adjacency is available.
seed_details.rebuttal: Adjacency and a terminating unique parent are precisely the missing geometric theorems; raw top-level deletion fails for most certified small-support facets.

seed_details.opportunity: Determine the exact exponential growth constant for the largest primitive facet coefficient and the minimal explicit representation length.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace finite facet enumeration by all-support lower families and determinant-based upper bounds, then close the exponential-base gap.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for coefficient growth of causal response-type polytopes found general determinant bounds but no result for the non-valley three-marginal family.
seed_details.cynical_objection: A Hadamard upper bound and one doubling family already settle the order, leaving only a combinatorial constant.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection does not kill mathematical novelty but correctly limits consumer value; the seed is retained only as a supporting theorem, not the proposal kernel.

seed_details.anchor: LuDingDasgupta2018, Proposition 1 and constructive Supplementary Part A
seed_details.opportunity: Characterize the full six-dimensional set of lower and upper unique-best endpoints and determine which endpoint vectors are jointly attainable by one latent mixture.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace separate triangular joint-table constructions by a common three-marginal coupling with simultaneous complementary-slackness conditions.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches found separately sharp pairwise ordinal benefit bounds but no joint attainability theorem for six three-dose endpoint coordinates.
seed_details.cynical_objection: The vector is merely the image of the same finite coupling polytope.
seed_details.rebuttal: Computability is immediate, but a closed joint-support-function system and constructive simultaneous attainment are not; the present project nevertheless prioritizes the more foundational complete facet stream.

seed_details.opportunity: Choose the dose maximizing the worst-case unique-best share under a strict-valley violation budget and derive a regret frontier against the oracle best dose.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: After deriving violation-indexed endpoint formulas, replace sign preservation by a finite robust treatment-choice comparison across three doses.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for partial-identification policy choice with ordinal unique-best welfare found general maximin rules but no three-dose unimodality-regret frontier.
seed_details.cynical_objection: Once the endpoint frontier is known, choosing the largest lower bound is mechanical.
seed_details.rebuttal: A nontrivial policy theorem would require sampling regret and tie geometry beyond the identification frontier; that extra layer is not sufficiently developed for this version.
